scheme_name: Natural Death Assistance for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Delhi
Applicant must be a building/construction worker registered with the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year
Nominee/dependent must have lost a registered member/worker due to natural death
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 is provided to the nominee/dependent of a worker who dies a natural death.
